data.outcome_summary: The OECD PISA 2022 financial literacy factsheet for Peru reports students’ proficiency distribution across levels (including baseline Level 2 and top Level 5) and compares Peru’s mean score to the OECD average. Peru’s average financial literacy score is 421, below the OECD average, with 42% of students below Level 2 and only 1% at Level 5. The factsheet also summarizes how much variation in financial literacy is associated with performance in mathematics and reading (82% explained by these domains, 18% by other domain-specific factors) and reports a residual advantage of 3 points for Peru relative to what would be expected from math/reading performance. It further documents associations with student characteristics (e.g., socioeconomic status) and self-reported financial behaviors and home/school financial education exposure.
